justification: Both surfaces are stone reliefs depicting a figure in profile carved in low relief, but A shows a narrative battle scene with archers, bows, and fortified city walls/towers, while B shows a single animal figure on an isolated monolith with no architectural or human elements. The lack of any shared narrative structure, human figures, or architectural motifs means the correspondence is limited to the generic use of profile relief carving rather than any specific iconographic scheme.
